defect: Status is set to validated while the artefact's own evidence says none is claimed. A synthetic validation scope is added only because approved A-003 makes it required for that status; it is not part of the defect. Passes the schemas.

diagnostics.message: Status "validated" is claimed, but the evidence statement says no evidence is claimed and no review has taken place.
diagnostics.hint: Return the status to draft, or record the validation with its version, population, setting and intended use.
